messages:
tess: Quick proposal: bring up rwd-v4-int4 for short-chat. Need clear AB/canary gates and auto-fallback before any traffic.

noah: Agreed. What are the must-have automatic triggers?

tess: Starter list: immediate rollback on P95 latency +50ms or P50 latency +100ms; immediate rollback on hallucination_delta >= 0.7pp (absolute); two-window confirmed rollback for QA drop >=1.0pp.

raj: Add a named-entity fidelity gate: abort if NER F1 drops >=1.5pp in any window. Also require min sample size 1.5k per arm for AB windows.

ops-bot: infra-check: GPU pools stable, no incidents in last 6h.

noah: Suggest shadow 12h, then AB 0.5%/0.5% for 6h. If stats stable and cost reduction >=35% live-measured, ramp 2%->10%->30% with 8h windows.

tess: Good. Also add a two-window debounce for QA/NER (to avoid noisy drop). Single-window for latency/hallucination.

alan: I'll wire the policy and page rules. Which channel for alerts? #eng-ml and paging to oncall.

tess: yes. Action: alan wire policy, raj run 2k micro-eval, noah shadow for 12h. We'll reconvene at +4h for an early snapshot. :thumbsup:
